headline: Union Bank reports 18.5% growth in advances for Q2
hook: Union Bank loan book expands significantly
summary: Union Bank of India reported a total advance growth of 18.5% to ₹11.56 lakh crore for the September quarter. Domestic advances saw a year-on-year increase of 17.4%. The bank's CASA deposits grew by 14.7%, pushing the total business volume past the ₹24.75 lakh crore mark.
why_it_matters: Strong credit growth signals healthy earnings potential for the bank.
